title: AI App Launch Rescue
summary: Before/after rescue of an AI-generated SaaS prototype—audit report, security fixes, and a stable production deploy.
problem: Teams ship Lovable/Cursor-style MVPs with exposed keys, weak auth, missing validation, and builds that fail in production—blocking a real launch.
solution: Documented findings in a client-style audit report, then hardened the same app: moved secrets server-side, added auth and per-user data isolation, validation and rate limits, safer rendering, and a passing Vercel deploy. The repo keeps intentional “before” and “after” folders for comparison.
